Private Function Merges(ByVal ws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim c As Range, s As String
    For Each c In ws.Range("A1:H10")
        If c.MergeCells Then
            If c.Address = c.MergeArea.Cells(1, 1).Address Then s = s & "|" & c.MergeArea.Address(0, 0) & "=" & c.Value
        End If
    Next
    s = s & " values"
    For Each c In ws.Range("A1:F8")
        If Not IsEmpty(c.Value) Then s = s & " " & c.Address(0, 0) & "=" & c.Value
    Next
    Merges = s
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("B2").Value = "m": ws.Range("B2:C3").Merge
    ws.Range("E5").Value = "n": ws.Range("E5:E6").Merge
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
    Case 1
        ws.Rows(1).Insert
    Case 2
        ws.Rows(3).Insert
    Case 3
        ws.Rows(2).Insert
    Case 4
        ws.Rows(4).Insert
    Case 5
        ws.Rows("3:4").Insert
    Case 6
        ws.Rows(1).Delete
    Case 7
        ws.Rows(2).Delete
    Case 8
        ws.Rows(3).Delete
    Case 9
        ws.Rows("2:3").Delete
    Case 10
        ws.Rows("1:2").Delete
    Case 11
        ws.Rows("3:5").Delete
    Case 12
        ws.Columns(1).Insert
    Case 13
        ws.Columns(3).Insert
    Case 14
        ws.Columns(2).Delete
    Case 15
        ws.Columns("B:C").Delete
    Case 16
        ws.Columns("C:E").Delete
    Case 17
        ws.Range("A1").Insert xlShiftDown
    Case 18
        ws.Range("B1").Insert xlShiftDown
    Case 19
        ws.Range("B1:C1").Insert xlShiftDown
    Case 20
        ws.Range("B1:D1").Insert xlShiftDown
    Case 21
        ws.Range("A2").Insert xlShiftToRight
    Case 22
        ws.Range("A2:A3").Insert xlShiftToRight
    Case 23
        ws.Range("B4").Delete xlShiftUp
    Case 24
        ws.Range("B2:C3").Delete xlShiftUp
    Case 25
        ws.Range("B2:C2").Delete xlShiftUp
    Case 26
        ws.Range("B2").EntireRow.Insert
    Case 27
        ws.Range("B2:C3").EntireColumn.Delete
    End Select
    Tried = "ok " & Merges(ws)
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Merges(ws)
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    For i = 0 To 27
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
